headline: A 2021 law renames a VA outpatient clinic in Aurora, Colorado, after Lieutenant Colonel John W. Mosley.
what_it_does: This law gives a new name to a community-based outpatient clinic run by the Department of Veterans Affairs in Aurora, Colorado. The clinic will be called the Lieutenant Colonel John W. Mosley VA Clinic. It is an honorary designation and does not change the clinic's services, staff, or operations.
when_it_takes_effect: Effective on the date it was enacted, November 12, 2021.
